summary: Master real estate syndication and crowdfunding with our expert-led training course. Gain the skills to elevate your investment strategy and achieve success.
lede: Real estate syndication training helps investment professionals assess pooled property deals and crowdfunding opportunities. Participants learn to interpret deal structures, investor rights, fees and projected returns, test assumptions and downside risks, and use due diligence to compare opportunities and prepare clear investment recommendations for committees, partners or stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who are actively involved in evaluating and making decisions about real estate investments. Whether you are assessing opportunities, providing financial support, or justifying investment choices, this course will equip you with the knowledge and tools you need.
audience: Investment committee members and board representatives
SACCO leaders and cooperative investment groups
Wealth managers, advisors, and relationship managers
modules: Foundations of Real Estate Syndication and Crowdfunding
Understanding Deal Structures and Investor Rights
Reading an Offering: The Documents That Matter
Returns and Cash Flow: How Money Actually Comes Back
Fees, Incentives, and Alignment: Follow the Money
Due Diligence Workflow for Syndication and Crowdfunding
Risk Management for Group Real Estate Investing
Compliance, Governance, and Ethics in Crowdfunded Real Estate
Building and Presenting an Investment Recommendation
Portfolio Thinking: Strategy, Liquidity, and Investment Fit
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of real estate and investment concepts. Familiarity with financial statements and investment analysis is beneficial but not required.
